messages.content: 请帮我生成一组多轮对话数据,里面包含了LLM function call

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
下面给出三组示例多轮对话，演示如何在对话中使用 `get_current_weather` 函数。每条对话都按 **角色 → 内容** 的顺序排列，并在需要调用函数时用 `function_call` 字段标记（内容为 `null`），随后是函数返回的消息（角色为 `"function"`）。所有传递给函数的参数以及函数返回值均以合法的 JSON 字符串形式出现。

```json
[
  [
    {"role":"user","content":"今天旧金山的天气怎么样？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"San Francisco, CA\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":18,\"description\":\"晴朗\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"旧金山现在气温 18°C，天气晴朗。"}
  ],

  [
    {"role":"user","content":"伦敦现在几点钟？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"抱歉，我无法直接获取当前时间，但可以帮你查询伦敦的天气情况。你想知道吗？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"好的，请告诉我你想查询的城市和州/国家。"},
    {"role":"user","content":"伦敦"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"London, UK\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":12,\"description\":\"多云\",\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"伦敦现在气温 12°F，天气多云。"}
  ],

  [
    {"role":"user","content":"东京现在的天气怎样？"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"get_current_weather","arguments":"{\"location\":\"Tokyo, Japan\",\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\"}"}},
    {"role":"function","name":"get_current_weather","content":"{\"temperature\":75,\"description\":\"阵雨\",\"unit\":\"fahrenheit\"}"},
    {"role":"assistant","content":"东京现在气温 75°F，正在下阵雨。"}
  ]
]
```

> **说明**  
> - 在 `function_call.arguments` 中，JSON 对象被转义成字符串，例如 `"{\"location\":\"San Francisco, CA\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"`。  
> - 函数返回的内容同样是一个 JSON 字符串，例如 `"{\"temperature\":18,\"description\":\"晴朗\",\"unit\":\"celsius\"}"`。  
> - 如果你想让对话更长或加入更多细节，只需继续添加新的 `{role, content}` 对即可。
